notes: tapFrac is the SCREEN centre of the real control, computed from its RectTransform over the 1242x2688 reference canvas and then corrected for the AspecterSA aspect fitter: FitInParent at 1242/2688 = 0.46205357 on the 1080x2400 capture device gives a 1080 x 2337.38 panel letterboxed by 31.31 px top and bottom, so screenY = (2400 - 31.31 - u * 2337.38) / 2400 where u is the control's fraction from the bottom of the panel. Every step lands on a different screen: the two menu boards are left by moving FORWARD, never by aiming at a close glyph.
